title: Split Step Hop (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Split step split step right when they swing
Light on the toes is the only thing
Split step split step ready to react
The split step keeps the timing intact

[Verse 1]
When the rival contacts the ball
Thats the moment to do the small jump call
Split step split step land light and wide
Knees bent ready paddle by your side
Vamos vamos light and small
Split step ready for the call
Land on the balls of the feet so quick
Thats the timing thats the trick

[Pre-Chorus]
Split step split step
Light on the toes
Split step split step
Ready where it goes

[Chorus]
Split step hop right when they swing
Split step hop the timing is king
Split step hop knees soft and wide
Split step hop ready by your side
Vamos vamos pa lante
Split step
Vamos vamos pa lante
Light on your step

[Verse 2]
Dont stand flat dont stand still
The split step gives you the will
Micro hop two inches off the ground
Land soft never make a sound
Uno dos tres land light
Ready to move left or right
Center mass low paddle out front
Split step ready to confront

[Bridge]
Common error split step too late
Do it with their swing not after the gate
Their contact is your trigger to hop
Thats the timing never stop

[Chorus]
Split step hop right when they swing
Split step hop the timing is king
Split step hop knees soft and wide
Split step hop ready by your side

[Outro]
Split step split step right when they swing
Light on the toes is the only thing
Split step split step ready to react
The split step keeps the timing intact
